scientific_integrity: A complete analytic derivation accompanies exact-rational short-block tests and finite spectral checks. These computations are corroborative rather than infinite proofs. No independently performed audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-balanced two-position windows only; no claim for wider windows, wider balance bands, synthesis dependence, sequencing, or correction; threshold formula at \(\varepsilon=1/k\) requires \(k\geq3\). Novelty is limited to uniform resolution-tolerance bounds, scaling exponent, and exact onset formula; the spectral capacity method is earlier.
title: A resolution–tolerance phase law for probabilistic two-position composite-DNA GC constraints
